artist.name: Peach Blok
artist.bio: Peach Blok is the Bengaluru DJ and producer Rishii Rohra. His productions lean laid-back, while his club sets move through house, acid, trance and breakbeats, as heard on his 2024 Wild City mix.

eras.sound: House grooves, acid, trance moods and breakbeats
